**1) Status line:** It reads exactly **`RELEASE BOTH: RAIJIN ZAN`** (left) with `DASH 45 | POWER 120` on the right — not "BLADE CHARGING...", so full dual charge is confirmed registered.

**2) 3px strip under the status line:** Yes — the thin white strip spans the **full panel width** (solid white, no visible fill gradient/segments), indicating a fully complete charge.

**3) Stickman pose:** He's in a **deep sunk coil** — knees deeply bent, hips low, body compressed forward over the leading leg. The sword arm is **chambered back-low behind the hip**, with the glowing cyan blade trailing back and angled upward along the scabbard line behind him (a sheath-style taut stance), **not** upright with blade raised. This matches the RAIJIN ZAN taut chamber description.

**4) Stamina:** **600 / 600** — full, consistent with charge held but not yet spent.

All four checks are consistent with the intended full-charge RAIJIN ZAN state. Ready for the release input (I+K) when you are.
